episode_row: dashboard "Final — pick missed" early on a cross-game double

commits.subject: fix: debut flag for limited-data pitchers + dashboard double-pick status
commits.body:
1. Pitchers with <10 career starts (like Bubba Chandler, 8 games) were
   flagged as "DEBUT" because pitcher_hr_30g requires min_periods=10.
   Now checks if pitcher_id exists in historical data — shows "LIMITED
   pitcher data" instead of "DEBUT" when they have some history.

2. Dashboard merge_scorecards used most-advanced status (Final > Live),
   so a double-pick with one Final + one Live game showed "Final — pick
   missed" prematurely. Now uses least-advanced status — only Final when
   ALL games are done.
